# ufbx

Unmodified upstream `ufbx.h` and `ufbx.c` from ufbx v0.23.0:

- Repository: https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx
- Commit: `fcc5d6ba444cfd3eb80677dba5e37e493941abe5`
- Source: https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx/tree/fcc5d6ba444cfd3eb80677dba5e37e493941abe5
- License: the MIT alternative in the accompanying upstream `LICENSE`.

The application uses the memory loader, limits parser allocations, and reads
external Base Color images itself. ufbx never opens external files implicitly.
